policy.name: Jammu and Kashmir Industrial Policy 2021-30
policy.order_no: Government Order No. 117-IND of 2021 dated 19-04-2021, Industries & Commerce Department (reported as '117-IND of 2020' in some sources)

zones.A: Zone A - areas other than Zone B (as declared/demarcated by UT Govt)
zones.B: Zone B - far-flung/remote areas declared by UT Govt; higher rates

zone_lookup: Zone A / Zone B demarcation is notified by the UT Government (Industries & Commerce Dept) for the central NCSS 2021 and reused by the UT policy (e.g. DG-set caps). The demarcation order/list could not be retrieved (J&K government sites unreachable from this environment).

schemes.name: Subsidy on DG Set
schemes.clause: J&K Industrial Policy 2021-30, incentive 'Subsidy on DG Set' (para no. not confirmed)
schemes.notes: 100% subsidy on purchase & installation of ONE new DG set of 10-2000 kW; cap Rs 40 lakh Zone A / Rs 45 lakh Zone B; once under the policy; new units, existing units and units undertaking substantial expansion. SOURCE: ICAI 'J&K State MSME Policies' handbook (startup.icai.org, June 2026) - secondary; official policy PDF not retrievable.

schemes.name: Subsidy on procurement of Quality Certificate
schemes.clause: J&K Industrial Policy 2021-30, 'Subsidy on procurement of Quality Certificate'
schemes.notes: 30% of cost of ISO/ISI/BIS/FPO/BEE/AGMARK/ECOMARK/ZED etc., max Rs 2 lakh, once, CA-certified. SOURCE: ICAI handbook (secondary).

schemes.name: Green and Environment Protection Initiative
schemes.clause: J&K Industrial Policy 2021-30, 'Green and Environment Protection Initiative'
schemes.notes: 50% of expenditure on new rainwater harvesting, wastewater recycling, zero discharge / solid waste management equipment. Cap not stated in the secondary source. SOURCE: ICAI handbook (secondary).

schemes.name: Subsidy on Automation (IT/BPR/online pollution control devices)
schemes.notes: 25% of expenditure on automation/software/hardware/BPR/online pollution control devices, max Rs 2 lakh. SOURCE: ICAI handbook (secondary).

schemes.name: SGST Incentive (existing units only)
schemes.clause: J&K Industrial Policy 2021-30, 'SGST Incentive' (separate order issued)
schemes.notes: 100% Net SGST reimbursement for 10 years from 01-04-2021, ONLY for units registered under GST in J&K on or before 31-03-2021 - NOT available to new units. No FCI-linked ceiling reported (rate_by_zone null). Also 'Turnover Incentive' for the same existing units: 3% of turnover (micro, max Rs 10 lakh/yr) / 2% (SME, max Rs 50 lakh/yr) for 5 consecutive years, overall annual scheme cap Rs 50 crore. SOURCE: ICAI handbook + ICAI newsletter Mar 2026 (secondary).

schemes.name: New Central Sector Scheme for Industrial Development of UT of J&K (NCSS 2021) - Capital Investment Incentive
schemes.clause: DPIIT notification (Ministry of Commerce & Industry) dated 19-02-2021, CII component
schemes.notes: level: central. 30% (Zone A, max Rs 5 cr) / 50% (Zone B, max Rs 7.5 cr) of investment in P&M (manufacturing); eligible units with investment up to Rs 50 crore. Other components: Capital Interest Subvention 6% p.a. for up to 7 years on loans up to Rs 500 crore for P&M; GST-linked incentive up to 300% of eligible P&M investment over 10 years; Working Capital Interest Subvention 5% for existing units, max 5 years, Rs 1 crore cap. Scheme period 01-04-2021 to 31-03-2037, outlay Rs 28,400 crore. REGISTRATION WINDOW 01-04-2021 to 30-09-2024 (disposal by 31-03-2025) and registration pauses at 115% of committed funds - so NOT open to a unit registering in Oct 2026 unless extended (no extension notice found). SOURCE: Khaitan & Co / Tribune / SCC Online / Drishti summaries (secondary); DPIIT/egazette text not retrievable.

schemes.name: NCSS 2021 - Capital Interest Subvention
schemes.clause: DPIIT notification dated 19-02-2021, Capital Interest Subvention component
schemes.notes: level: central. 6% p.a. for max 7 consecutive years on loans up to Rs 500 crore for P&M; registration closed 30-09-2024 (see CII entry). SOURCE: secondary summaries.

other_benefits: Stamp duty & court fee: 100% exemption on land transactions in Govt industrial estates incl. lease and mortgage deeds for new/expanding units (UT policy; secondary)
Turnover incentive for existing GST-registered (<=31-03-2021) units: 3% micro / 2% SME for 5 yrs (secondary)
NCSS 2021 Working Capital Interest Subvention 5% for existing units, max 5 yrs, Rs 1 crore cap (central; secondary)
NCSS 2021 GST-linked incentive up to 300% of eligible investment over 10 years (central; secondary)
Land premium rebate for early start of production under J&K Industrial Land Allotment Policy 2021-30 (10%/5%)

Exact clause numbers of the UT policy not confirmed.
Deputy CM has announced an amendment to the J&K Industrial Policy 2021-30 (recalibrating incentives, sick-unit parity) - no notified amendment found.

NCSS 2021 registration closed 30-09-2024; a PIB-style page mentions registration up to 31-03-2026 under a 'proposed' scheme - status unconfirmed. No central J&K scheme appears open for new registrations on 17-10-2026.
The older central Industrial Development Scheme for J&K 2017 (DIPP F.No. 2(2)/2018-SPS, 23-04-2018) ran 15-06-2017 to 31-03-2022 and has expired (verified from the gazette copy on ladakh.gov.in).
